header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: وَرَطْبَكُمْ وَيَابِسَكُمْ اِجْتَمَعُوا فَكَانُوا عَلَي قَلْبِ أَتْقَي عَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِي لَمْ يَزِدْ فِي مُلْكِي جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا فَكَانُوا عَلي قَلْبِي أَشْقَي عَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِي لَمْ يَنْقُصْ مِنْ مُلْكِي جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ وَلَوْ أَنَّ حَيَّكُمْ وَمَيِّتَكُمْ وَأَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَرَطْبَكُمْ وَيَابِسَكُمُ اِجْتَمَعُوا فَسَأَلَ كُلُّ سَائِلٍ مِّنْهُمْ مَابَلَغَتْ أُمْنِيَّتُهُ مَانَقَصَ مِنْ مُلْكِي إِلَّا كَمَا لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ مَرَّ بِشَفَةِ الْبَحْرِ فَغَمَسَ فِيهَا إِبْرَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعَهَا ذلِكَ بِأَنِّي جَوَادٌ مَّاجِدٌ عَطَائِي كَلَامٌ إِذَا أَرَدْتُّ شَيْئاً فَإِنَّمَا أَقُولُ لَهُ: كُنْ فَيَكُونُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب ذكر التوبة رقم:٤٢٥٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “O My servants! All of you are sinners except the one whom I have protected! So ask Me for forgiveness, and I will forgive you. If anyone, knowing that I have the power to forgive, asks for forgiveness, I forgive him. All of you are astray except the one whom I have given guidance! So ask Me for guidance, and I will show you guidance. All of you are poor except those whom I have made rich! So ask of Me, and I will fulfil your needs. If those of you who are living and those who are dead, the first of you and the last of you, the wet and the dry things — all of them became human beings and gathered together, and all of them became like the man with the heart that fears Allah Ta'ala the most, they could not add even as much as a mosquito's wing to My dominion. And if all of them gathered together and became like the man with the disposition to sin the most, they could not cause a decrease even as much as a mosquito's wing in My kingdom.
